name: Related Custodian Message Details SD 1
definition: Provides selected corporate action events message details extracted from the related custodian messages received.

ReceivedEventType.name: Received Event Type
ReceivedEventType.definition: Reference the CAEV value from the received custodian message. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivedMandatoryVoluntaryEventType.name: Received Mandatory Voluntary Event Type
ReceivedMandatoryVoluntaryEventType.definition: Reference the CAMV value from the received custodian message. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivedCorporateActionEventIdentificati.name: Received Corporate Action Event Identification
ReceivedCorporateActionEventIdentificati.definition: Reference the CORP value from the received custodian message. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivedDate.name: Received Date
ReceivedDate.definition: Rate that the ISO message was received from the custodian. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivedTime.name: Received Time
ReceivedTime.definition: Time of day that the ISO message was received from the custodian. Applicable to custodian service only.

InboundISOMessageType.name: Inbound ISO Message Type
InboundISOMessageType.definition: Reference of the ISO15022 MT message type received from the custodian message. Applicable to custodian service only.

InboundISOMessageReceiverBIC.name: Inbound ISO Message Receiver BIC
InboundISOMessageReceiverBIC.definition: BIC Code of the recipient of the custodian record on a received message. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivedRelatedReference.name: Received Related Reference
ReceivedRelatedReference.definition: Sender related reference from the received custodian message. Applicable to custodian service only.

ReceivedSenderMessageReference.name: Received Sender Message Reference
ReceivedSenderMessageReference.definition: Sender SEME from received custodian message. Applicable to custodian service only.

InboundISOMessageSenderBIC.name: Inbound ISO Message Sender BIC
InboundISOMessageSenderBIC.definition: BIC Code of the sender of the custodian record on a received message. Applicable to custodian service only.
